title: Generative AI Carries Non-Democratic Biases and Stereotypes: Representation of Women, Black Individuals, Age Groups, and People with Disability in AI-Generated Images across Occupations
reasoning: The paper focuses on empirical measurement and quantification of demographic biases (gender, race, age, and disability) in images generated by AI tools. While it mentions the field of AI ethics and governance, it does not evaluate religious beliefs, spiritual traditions, or formal moral/ethical frameworks.
